item.text: I found the status calculation in `lib/auth/trustedcluster.go`. It currently replaces the cluster heartbeat with the latest remaining tunnel heartbeat, so removing the newest tunnel can move the reported time backward. I’ll preserve the stored maximum and write status changes through the new presence method.
